Vince DiMartino has led a distinguished career as a jazz educator and master of the trumpet. His teaching philosophy and his versatility in all genres of music have made him an invaluable contributor to the jazz and classical worlds.
Vince was interviewed via Zoom on January 8, 2025 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have Vince DiMartino with me today. And we’re pretending you’re in Greece, is that correct?
Oh yeah. My mind is there a lot of times, every day.
Yeah. Well you’re a world traveler and you can’t see this because it’s in front of me but in the wall in front of me I have six pages of your resume.
On the right I have a page of handwritten notes, and on the left another page, and then I have these pages that I don’t have room for.
So my first question is how did you fit all this in?
